description: C3-symmetric convex 12-gon in which every vertex has exactly three other vertices at one common distance (K3 everywhere, radius depends on the vertex). Found by c3_symmetric_search.py (K=3, M=4, seed 7, SEP 0.3); coordinates rounded to 5 decimals; verify_multiplicity.py with tolerance 1e-4 reports min_cross 2.18e-3, min_sep 0.3199, all multiplicities 3.
